spec.description:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Haven is an expansive acoustic workstation screen
system designed to provide comprehensive visual and sound shielding in open-plan
offices. Featuring an extended wrapped boundary format that encloses the back
and side of a desk, Haven achieves an impressive acoustic rating of 1.55 Sabins
per unit. Attached using non-destructive Vicinity Desk Clamps, it is formed
from 100% polyester fibre with an 80% recycled PET core and meets Group 1 fire
safety requirements.

required

Clamps
made from 100% recycled PET (RePET) or powdercoated zinc

Moisture and mould

Certified Carbon Neutral
product with third-party verified EPD

install: Unpack Vicinity Haven screen pieces and layout around workstation perimeter
Slide Vicinity Workstation Clamps into pre-routed slots in the screen

Align
the wrapped corner treatment to wrap neatly around the desk edges

Tighten
clamp screws from the underside of desktop using an Allen key

Ensure screen
sits firmly upright, enclosing rear and side boundaries securely
selection_checklist:
Confirm desk size (Haven 1600 for 1600mm desks or
Haven 1800 for 1800mm desks)

Verify desk edge clearance around monitor arms
and cable trays
Select colour from the Autex Cube palette

Confirm required
pack quantity (packs of 4 screens, 2 pieces per screen)

Check that user
egress is unobstructed by the wrap-around screen
limitations:
Indoor use only; avoid wet
areas or direct liquid contact

Requires compatible desk edge overhang for
clamp engagement

Ensure wrap-around screen width matches exact workstation
desk size

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Vicinity Desk
Screen - Haven is an extended wrap-around acoustic desk screen system engineered
from 12mm Cube polyester felt to enclose the rear and side of 1600mm or 1800mm
desks. Delivering an outstanding sound absorption rating of 1.55 Sabins per
unit, it forms an acoustic and visual sanctuary that shields workers from
open-office chatter. Secured non-destructively via 100% recycled PET Vicinity
Clamps and achieving Group 1 fire compliance, Haven offers a circular,
high-performance workstation partition solution.
